# RandomMarkovTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network graph whose edge weights are drawn from a random Markov transition matrix, capturing stochastic dynamics over a fixed topological structure. Offers a baseline model for analyzing how random connectivity patterns in TCC interconnects affect global computational stability and convergence.
